tools.name: unpublish_page
tools.description: Take a page offline without deleting it: its URL shows an "offline" notice to viewers, and the content, id, URL and view count are kept. Pass restore: true to put it back online at the same URL. Prefer this over delete_page when the human wants a page hidden or paused. Calling it twice is harmless.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page: its URL stops working at once. The maker gets only a brief undo in the dashboard, then it is purged for good (there is no restore tool). findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_email" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_page, list_pages, get_page, unpublish_page, create_account, verify_email · Private data: create_account, verify_email · Public sink: publish_page, create_account, verify_email · Destructive: delete_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_page, list_pages, get_page, unpublish_page, create_account, verify_email · Private data: create_account, verify_email · Public sink: publish_page, create_account, verify_email · Destructive: delete_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
